title: Caller-policy mapped-circle queries and provenance-safe compact caches
decision: retain rational and analytic-parallel query policy forwarding and actual-consumption cache replay; preserve the original cache-entry size and delete the redundant test-only bracket interface

milestone_status.exactcorelib_mining_and_recorded_uplift: closed before this checkpoint; no new milestone closure

source.counting_note: Production-prefix accounting includes deletion of the test-only rational-map bracket forwarder outside conversion_tests; the second figure includes the bezier_region test-call change. These are source-line counts, not compiled code-size estimates.
source.public_api: unchanged; two map methods become private and the test-only forwarding interface is deleted; no compatibility alias, shim, or alternate kernel
source.behavior: Rational and analytic-parallel angular ordering and bracket refinement use the requested policy, including rational promotion and retained-chord replay. Brackets retain consumed policy and refinement depth, choose the strongest equally refined admissible seed, and never replay terminal-consumed seeds in STRICT or forced-strict subpasses. Rational values and represented diameter coordinates retain actual terminal provenance, observe it on permitted replay, and upgrade on independent certification without downgrading existing certified evidence. Only terminal-consumed rational payloads are boxed; certified values stay inline.

regressions.baseline: All five new tests fail against unchanged main production with the byte-identical final conversion_tests module. Cold parallel/rational ordering and parallel bracket queries refuse the permitted terminal; rational-value and diameter caches forget an earlier consumed terminal. Both pre-existing chamfer tests pass on original production.
regressions.intermediate: Policy forwarding alone exposes approximate bracket laundering into STRICT. Adding policy identities still permits forced-strict reuse until actual terminal permission is checked. The first full wide-entry qualification fails two existing tests: cache entry 104 versus 96 bytes and a chamfer round-trip whose rational map still evaluates under construction STRICT. Nine other gates pass. Forwarding the rational caller policy fixes the ordering; boxing only terminal-consumed rational values restores the 96-byte entry. All earlier sources and terminal logs are preserved, not treated as final qualification.
regressions.candidate: All five new tests and both existing guards pass. The matched layout-only control uses the final production and tests except that terminal-consumed rational values are inline. It passes all five new regressions and the transverse chamfer test; only the expected cache-size guard fails. The passing rational-cache workload is used for the isolated box-allocation comparison.
regressions.artifacts_scope: Early baseline/policy-only/cache-candidate/forced-before sources contain earlier test modules. The superseded full wide-entry epoch and its builds/profiles are under wide-entry-qualification; the earlier 910-test matched control and profiles are under matched-baseline-910. Final matched-baseline, layout-control, and candidate each carry the same 912-test catalog. Only these final controls supply unit/heap comparison results.

no_default_features.ignored_coverage: all four opt-in tests pass in the full run

build_control.dependencies: All six crate sources are archived from their recorded HEADs. No dependency points into a concurrent live worktree. Concurrent Hyperreal formatting and inverse-trigonometric/hyperbolic/logarithm edits remain excluded and untouched.
build_control.unit_features: all features including dispatch-trace and comparative-benchmarks; matching 912-test catalogs and byte-identical final conversion_tests modules
build_control.native_benchmark_features: default features; three named release benchmarks; baseline production is unchanged by the added test catalog
build_control.timing_context: Three alternating pairs and seven additional native pairs pinned to CPU7 after owned qualification/build/profile workers completed. CPU3 Callgrind and Heaptrack records are instruction/allocation evidence, not wall-time comparisons.

quality.rule:
# Prespecified single timing retry

The first complete matrix and follow-up are preserved in variable-host-timing
and excluded from interpreted elapsed-time comparisons due to a large state
change affecting both unchanged binaries.

Rerun the same three alternating CPU7 pairs and seven native pairs once,
without changing either binary, the fixtures, iteration counts, source,
features, host configuration, or desktop processes.

For each whole-process fixture except the mapped test, whose centisecond
timer has insufficient resolution, compute max(elapsed)/min(elapsed)
separately for each variant and each of the two matrices. If any ratio
exceeds 1.5, mark the retry's elapsed-time comparison inconclusive. Keep all
samples regardless; do not select subranges or retry again in this checkpoint.

Stable ranges do not prove an idle or controlled machine. Report the full
range and lane costs, along with desktop/frequency/scheduling limitations.
Correctness qualification, completed raw allocation accounting, instruction
counts, and binary sizes remain separate evidence.

excluded_attempt.reason: Both the unchanged baseline and candidate underwent a large runtime state shift and recovery. All samples are preserved, but their aggregate latency changes are not interpreted as code effects; the cause is not established.

quality.mapped_timer: Both median values can round to zero at centisecond resolution; a null percentage is not a performance result.

memory.scope: Complete Heaptrack format-3 raw streams of one libtest invocation per variant, not geometry-only accounting or an ecosystem leak claim. Compressed streams validate and the streaming counter reconciles final live state. Final controls have identical test catalogs and measured test bodies; executable names differ. Byte-level startup differences are not claimed as geometry savings.

terminal_payload_control.scope: Passing layout-only control versus candidate; not the original-production binary that fails this regression.

layout.diameter_coordinate: Its existing boxed payload now also stores one CurveContext; no second coordinate-cache allocation is introduced.

limitations: Not a universal performance or full Hypercurve release-readiness claim.
Pair, chord, overlap-pair, and specialized mapped-circle query families still require their own policy/cache audit.
Lower-stack and Hypermesh source are unchanged in this slice.
Concurrent Hyperreal changes remain owned by the separate reference audit and are neither committed nor qualified here.
Desktop load and frequency scaling remain uncontrolled.
No push, publication, deployment, fresh fuzz campaign, or fresh coverage run.
followups: Continue requested-policy and cache-provenance audits across the remaining mapped-circle families. The pair-map first/second angular-order and bracket methods are four thin forwarding methods whose callers can use the existing side-aware authority.
Integrate the independent Hyperreal formatting/range repairs once finalized and qualified.
Evaluate rational equality delegation to its existing exact comparison authority before adding any parallel filter.
Continue the single authoritative CurveRegion2 kernel/API cleanup and full release/completeness audit; this checkpoint is progress, not goal completion.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail
map_evidence=/home/tim/Documents/GitHub/workspace/hypercurve/target/mapped-circle-policy.mZTiBS

map_status=$?

    printf '%s %s\n' "$map_case" "$map_status"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
replay_root=/home/tim/Documents/GitHub/workspace/hypercurve/target/mapped-circle-policy.mZTiBS
for replay_round in 1 2 3; do
    if (( replay_round % 2 )); then
        replay_order="baseline candidate"
    else
        replay_order="candidate baseline"
    fi
    for replay_case in selected chord radial contacts mapped; do
        case "$replay_case" in
            selected) replay_test=selected_fiber_genuinely_analytic_contacts_complete_region_booleans ;;
            chord) replay_test=recursive_selected_radial_diameter_chord_intersects_a_rational_quadratic_strict ;;
            radial) replay_test=recursively_pair_radial_circle_intersects_a_genuine_analytic_parallel ;;
            contacts) replay_test=selected_parallel_normal_circle_retains_general_rational_contacts_in_one_fiber ;;
            mapped) replay_test=mapped_overlap_retains_distinct_selected_inverse_keys_and_rebuilds_expired_values ;;
        esac
        for replay_variant in $replay_order; do
            replay_binary="$replay_root/$replay_variant-test"
            if [[ "$replay_variant" == baseline ]]; then replay_binary="$replay_root/matched-baseline-test"; fi
            /usr/bin/time -f 'elapsed_s=%e user_s=%U system_s=%S max_rss_kib=%M exit=%x' \
                -o "$replay_root/paired-$replay_case-$replay_round-$replay_variant.time" \
                taskset -c 7 "$replay_binary" \
                "bezier_offset::conversion_tests::$replay_test" --exact --include-ignored --test-threads=1 \
                > "$replay_root/paired-$replay_case-$replay_round-$replay_variant.log" 2>&1
            printf '%s %s %s passed\n' "$replay_case" "$replay_round" "$replay_variant"
        done
    done
    for replay_bench in bezier_region rational_bezier; do
        for replay_variant in $replay_order; do
            /usr/bin/time -f 'elapsed_s=%e user_s=%U system_s=%S max_rss_kib=%M exit=%x' \
                -o "$replay_root/paired-$replay_bench-$replay_round-$replay_variant.time" \
                taskset -c 7 "$replay_root/$replay_variant-$replay_bench" \
                > "$replay_root/paired-$replay_bench-$replay_round-$replay_variant.log" 2>&1
        done
    done
    for replay_fixture in rectangles circles capsules; do
        unset HYPERCURVE_CURVE_REGION_BATCH_FIXTURE
        if [[ "$replay_fixture" != rectangles ]]; then
            export HYPERCURVE_CURVE_REGION_BATCH_FIXTURE="$replay_fixture"
        fi
        for replay_variant in $replay_order; do
            HYPERCURVE_CURVE_REGION_BATCH_ITERATIONS=1000 \
                taskset -c 7 "$replay_root/$replay_variant-curve_region_boolean_batch" \
                > "$replay_root/paired-$replay_fixture-$replay_round-$replay_variant.log" 2>&1
        done
    done
done
